name: Service Wire Co
old_description: Since 1968, we've built a reputation for safely manufacturing high-quality wire and cable, delivering industry-leading service levels, and creating shared sustainable growth for employees and partners.
about:
Service Wire Co was founded in 1968 in Culloden, West Virginia, as a family-owned wire and cable manufacturer. The company remains multi-generation family-owned and operates its corporate headquarters in Culloden, with additional offices in Houston, Texas, and Phoenix, Arizona.

The company produces a range of wire and cable products including bare copper, single conductors, twisted cables, tray cable, armored cables, VFD cable systems, and submersible pump cable. Manufacturing is supported by an in-house UL laboratory that tests every order, and an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system. The firm emphasizes same-day shipping from stock for one- to two-day delivery and offers 24/7 emergency service year-round.

Service Wire serves heavy commercial, industrial, utility, renewable energy, and pump markets across North America, with a dedicated Canadian division. Its products are specified for applications such as EV charging infrastructure, roadway lighting, semiconductor manufacturing, and overhead power distribution.

The company differentiates itself by sourcing and manufacturing 100% of its copper wire and cable in the United States, holding BABA compliance and NEMA's Make It American Certification. A recent groundbreaking in Culloden signals a major manufacturing expansion to support growing demand.
